BiblicalUsage: Na'ar means to growl or roar, and its only occurrence is a picture of proud enemies brought low. In Jeremiah 51:38 the people of Babylon roar together like lions and yell as lions' whelps, loud and sure of themselves just before the fall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a roar is not strength when God has already spoken; Babylon sounds like a lion in Jeremiah 51:38, and the verse itself is the sentence.
